name: The Pedal Point

detectability.signature: Continuous 41-minute gravitational wave emission; X-ray gold accretion spectrum visible system-wide

proximity: Background stars smear into concentric arcs of bent light
Course solutions decay as instruments disagree about local mass
contact: Tidal gradients begin stressing the hull beyond structural tolerance
Time dilation desynchronizes ship chronometers from fleet standard
prolonged_exposure: Crossing the horizon guarantees molecular spaghettification of the vessel
No signal, matter, or information escapes once captured

phenomena: Light bending around the anomaly in permanent concentric arcs
Gravitational lensing of background stars into a crown geometry
Time dilation effects near the accretion disk boundary
known_incidents: Research station Deep Cadenza was dragged past the horizon in 2251 when its anchor tether failed; its final transmission was the pure 41-minute tone, unbroken until silence.
description: A perfect absence ringed by fire: the event horizon spans a city, while its accretion disk smears X-ray gold across a tenth of an astronomical unit. Background stars bend into concentric arcs around it, a permanent crown of wrong geometry. Gravitational wave observatories hear it as a single sustained tone, forty-one minutes long, never varying.

The Pedal Point holds its position and its pitch; nothing about it has changed in recorded history or in six billion years of nearby geology. Approaching vessels feel their course solutions rot as instruments disagree about local mass. Inside the disk's inner edge, physics stops negotiating.

Research station Deep Cadenza was dragged past the horizon in 2251 when its anchor tether failed, and its final transmission was the 41-minute tone, unbroken until silence. The anomaly anchors all local navigation: every chart in the sector is drawn relative to its immovable bass note. Physicists test quantum gravity against its horizon and publish humbled.

Traffic keeps a respectful forty-light-hour margin, and insurance policies exclude the disk entirely. Energy consortiums lease the outer magnetosphere for power extraction, with mixed results and spectacular footage. The tone has not skipped once, and several faiths hold this to be significant.
